$comment: Boot-payload budget (#485 D), enforced by `node scripts/check-build-manifest.mjs --budget` in the 'Build without Emscripten' CI job and mirrored into vite.config.ts build.chunkSizeWarningLimit. Sizes are raw (un-gzipped) bytes of build/assets/*.js; 1 kB = 1000 bytes like Vite's reporter. Raise a number only with a reason in the PR; lower it whenever a phase earns the room.
entryNote: Ceiling = the entry after the validators left the boot path (1,165,739 B) rounded up to the next kB. #485 C left it at 1,354,581 B because registry.ts validated the bundled maps at import and ReachStreamer/useLevel imported the validators statically; the bundled maps are now checked only by registry.contract.test.ts and the validators load on demand (levelValidator ~98 kB, reachValidator ~94 kB chunks). The remaining ~466 kB to entryTargetBytes is app code and eager three/jsm add-ons, tracked in its own issue.
totalJsNote: Issue #485 asks for <= 3.5 MB raw. Total JS counts every chunk, so moving the validators into lazy chunks cannot lower it: it went 3,512,137 -> 3,515,342 B (+3.2 kB of chunk-split overhead) while the boot entry fell 189 kB. The ceiling is today's number rounded up; the gap to the target is printed on every run and needs code actually removed, not moved.
